verdict.rationale: The evidence names one built-in assistant: NVIDIA Project G-Assist, described as "an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system." That counts as a way to delegate system tasks. However, it rests on a single marketing line, the "Project" label suggests experimental status, and it is a companion software layer rather than something built into the GPU hardware. Missing for 10: documentation of which tasks G-Assist can perform and how delegation works, its availability and maturity status, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
